mapper.delete: DELETE FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT EVENT_ID FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO WHERE (OCCUPY_DATE < #{sysDate} or OCCUPY_DATE is null) AND EVENT_ID = T1.EVENT_ID and uuid=T1.uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO_HIS SELECT UUID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, OCCUPY_DATE, ENTRUST_CODE, PROD_ID, ASSET_CODE, ASSET_TYPE, ASSET_TYPE2, PS, AMOUNT, PRICE_AMT, TRADE_NUM, NET_PRICE, ALL_PRICE, UNIT_NET, ASSET_RATE, TRADER, MANAGER, DELIVERY_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE, OCP_STATUS, WFL_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, SEQ_NO FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT EVENT_ID FROM RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO WHERE (OCCUPY_DATE < #{sysDate} or OCCUPY_DATE is null) AND EVENT_ID = T1.EVENT_ID and uuid=T1.uuid)

INSERT INTO RSK_OCCUPY_INFO_HIS SELECT UUID, EVENT_DATE, EVENT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, ENTRUST_CODE, OCCUPY_CODE, PROD_ID, ASSET_CODE, ASSET_TYPE, ASSET_TYPE2, PS, AMOUNT, PRICE_AMT, TRADE_NUM, NET_PRICE, ALL_PRICE, UNIT_NET, ASSET_RATE, TRADER, MANAGER, DELIVERY_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE, OCP_STATUS, WFL_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, SEQ_NO FROM RSK_OCCUPY_INFO T --将平台日(跑批日)之前的实占数据备份到历史表中（剔除实占记录对应预占数据生效的那部分实占数据） WHERE T.EVENT_DATE < #{sysDate} AND T.EVENT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT t1.EVENT_ID FROM RSK_OCCUPY_INFO t1 INNER JOIN RSK_PRE_OCCUPY_INFO t2 ON t1.OCCUPY_CODE = t2.EVENT_ID WHERE t2.OCCUPY_DATE >= #{sysDate} AND t2.OCP_STATUS = '0' )
